title: Pokémon Card Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon ex RR 022/101 SV6 - U.S. Seller
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon card features the fierce Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon, with a stunning holo finish. It is a 1st edition card from the Mask of Change set, manufactured by Nintendo in Japan. The card is a Japanese size and has a card number of 022/101, making it a valuable addition to any collection. 

The card has a dark attribute and abnormal creature/monster type, with 130 HP and 0 defense/toughness. It is a basic stage card with a unique specialty of EX, and features the illustrations of Hitoshi Ariga. The card is made of high-quality paper material and has a cost of 0. It is suitable for children aged 4+ and is perfect for collectors and fans of the Pokémon Trading Card Game.
